hints.title: Small Upper Bound Principle
hints.text: Any connected island on a 2D grid can always be disconnected in at most 2 days by isolating an articulation or corner cell.

hints.title: Zero Days Check
hints.text: Count connected components initially. If the count does not equal 1, the grid is already disconnected (return 0).

hints.title: One Day Articulation Check
hints.text: Temporarily convert each land cell to water and test if the component count is no longer 1. If so, return 1; otherwise return 2.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Component counting executes in O(R * C) time, repeated at most R * C times for each candidate removal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: General graph cut algorithms are unnecessary given the tight mathematical bound of at most 2 removals.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating cell removals sequentially bounds extra space to a single visited set.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deducing the answer is in {0, 1, 2} and verifying 0 and 1 via flood-fill.
